login.title: Sign in to TCMS
login.body: You will continue to your organization's secure sign-in page.

planned.title: {{screen}} — coming soon
planned.body: This screen is planned for sprint {{sprint}}. See the frontend guide for its scope.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: Your account does not have permission to open this page. Ask your administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page does not exist or is not available to your account.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: TCMS could not load. Try again in a moment.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach TCMS. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.CONFLICT: This item was changed by someone else. It has been refreshed; review it and try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: TCMS had a problem completing this request.
